# Dave Patton Real Estate

## About

Dave Patton is a Realtor® and Certified Senior Housing Professional (CSHP) serving the greater Birmingham and Hoover, Alabama area. He operates under Patton Real Estate, affiliated with KW Hoover (Keller Williams), at 1021 Brocks Gap Pkwy, Hoover, AL.

Dave is one of only two agents in Alabama to hold the CSHP designation from the Seniors Real Estate Institute — a certification requiring months of rigorous coursework and examination.

## Expertise

- Senior housing transitions and downsizing
- Assisted living and memory care relocation coordination
- Estate and family caregiver real estate
- Residential home sales and purchases across Hoover and Birmingham, AL
- Hyper-local market knowledge: Lake Wilborn, Stadium Trace Village, Abingdon

## Services

- Helping seniors right-size or downsize with dignity and minimal stress
- Coordinating real estate decisions with assisted living, memory care, and caregiver arrangements
- Educating seniors, adult children, and caregivers through in-person seminars and workshops
- Monthly Home Report: local market stats, neighborhood news, community events
- Full buyer and seller representation in the Birmingham and Hoover markets

## Background

Originally from Atlanta, Georgia. Undergraduate degree from Oglethorpe University. Career background in consulting and television industry. Transitioned to real estate after personal experience navigating senior housing decisions with aging family members. Serves as President of the BNI Advisory Board and is an active BNI member.
